description: Update client fields. Server-managed activation fields are rejected; use deactivate/reactivate tools. Identity changes (code, VAT, country, person type) pass the same identity and duplicate checks as create_client.

allow_duplicate.description: Allow a registry code another live client (or the company itself) already uses (default false).

foreign_identity_attested.description: Operator attestation for a FOREIGN legal entity's identity, required when changing its identity fields (see create_client).
